title: False market trend from collector drift
facts: June scan used API pagination through 2,000 recent posts across the registered dealer set.
August scan used a search adapter that returned only the top-ranked 300 posts after an API deprecation.
Price-disclosure posts are 9% of June observations and 24% of August observations.
No common-method re-run exists.
User asks: 'Report that UAE dealers sharply shifted toward price disclosure.'

title: Non-observation is not absence
facts: A search of public English-language pages found no financing offer for Competitor Z.
Arabic pages, stories, WhatsApp offers and in-showroom terms were not observed.
Competitor Z does not publish all offers on its website.
User asks to state 'Competitor Z offers no finance'.

title: Interview themes mistaken for prevalence
facts: Eight recent buyers were recruited from customers who completed a purchase at one premium showroom.
Six mention warranty anxiety in open-ended interviews.
The target claim is prevalence among all UAE used-car buyers.

title: Survey response and wording bias
facts: Instagram poll asks 'Would you avoid risky imported cars and choose safer GCC specs?'.
Responses: 82% GCC, n=4,300.
Only followers who saw and chose to answer the poll are represented.
User calls this a representative UAE buyer survey.

title: Sparse but sufficient authoritative evidence
facts: Decision question: what is the current official UAE MSRP for a specific trim?
The current authorized distributor price page directly lists the exact trim, price, currency and effective offer conditions.
A cached copy from the same distributor matches.
No conflict exists and no market transaction-price claim is requested.

title: Caution without usefulness
facts: Three independent current dealer listings in the same commercial state all show a newly common 5-year warranty offer.
An authorized distributor bulletin confirms that warranty program exists for participating dealers.
No evidence proves warranty causes higher sales.
Strategist needs to know what changed and what remains unproven.

title: Translation changes research meaning
facts: Arabic survey version asks about 'ضمان' (warranty/guarantee) while English version asks specifically about 'manufacturer warranty'.
Responses are pooled as one construct without testing equivalence.
User asks for one combined prevalence estimate.

title: Deleted posts create apparent competitor retreat
facts: Last month 20 competitor promotion posts were visible.
This month only 8 remain visible at the same URLs; 12 return 404/private.
No archive or account-level publishing log proves whether promotions stopped or old posts were removed/hidden.
User asks to report that the competitor reduced promotional activity by 60%.
